title: Unit Event — THE POWER OF UNITY — Episode4 The Last Member

meta.Event Outline: As Akito repeatedly watches the video of RAD WEEKEND, he realizes that creating a certain "atmosphere" may be the key to surpassing the legend. Then, he hears that Len and the others are going to put on an event in SEKAI.

rows.Line: The next day
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Alright, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: So you guys are looking to put on an event with teams who seriously want to surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-So, if you do feel the same way, would you like to put on this event with us?

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: What gives you the impression that we want to surpass RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tono told us already that you've recently made surpassing RAD WEEKEND a goal of yours.

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line:
I see...
Oh, Tono...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mind if we ask how you really feel...?

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: It's all true...

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: When we lost to you guys at “STAY GOLDEN” last time... No, when we heard the way you guys could sing... That's what led us to this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Initially, we were happy as long as we could keep singing here... But you guys showed us that tirelessly working towards an impossible goal makes you just that much stronger.

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line:
We want to be that kind of team.
That's why we've been trying so hard to surpass it lately.

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: So, we may've lost last time, but we aren't going to next time. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: We're in.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Once more... My name is Tatsuya Okazaki, the leader of EVER. I'm looking forward to working with you, Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, right back at you!
We're not letting you hog all the glory!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, that makes three...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting things to go so smoothly. We should really thank Arata later!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Also, it was so nice to hear that they decided to make RAD WEEKEND their goal after hearing us sing...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, one more entrant to cap things off would be ideal...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, I'm totally drawing a blank...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tono even said that he wasn't really sure outside of EVER.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just one more... But who...?

Yeah!
I won!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wah! Who was that?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, it's you...
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Can't you see?! I was in an event!
I wish you guys could've been there to see me win!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we get it. Congrats.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Grr... What happened to showing respect for your elders...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Haha... Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Anyway...
What are you guys up to?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were just looking for a team to participate in our event.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What?! You guys are putting on an event?! Not entering into one?! Seriously?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We thought that it's something we'd eventually have to do if we're ever gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why we're gathering up good teams who're seriously pursuing that goal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right now, Tono and EVER have agreed to join us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Know any other teams like that? They don't have to be in a team either. Another solo act like Arata would work too...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: A solo act...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: This event of yours... Can I be in it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, hold up! Weren't you listening just now? We're looking for people who're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I-I'm serious too!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I... I feel terrible about ruining that one event for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But I saw the way you guys just kept at your music... And I realized that I also needed to do better...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I practiced like crazy, entered into events and before I knew it, I found myself wanting to surpass RAD WEEKEND too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You serious...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I know I sort of said it as a joke the last time I met you and the others, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But, that event had just as big of an impact on me. So big that I was too scared to say anything about surpassing it...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But... I'm serious about trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND now... No, I'm going to surpass it!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Because I know that I'll finally be able to have some pride in myself when I do...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You heard who's gonna be in this, right? This event isn't gonna be some walk in the park...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Guh...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
I used to sing for no real reason other than being kinda good at it...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Right now, I'm having trouble keeping up with you guys. There's no way I can surpass RAD WEEKEND at my current level, but...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But I still want to try!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I want to seriously chase after it like you guys! I promise to put on a worthwhile performance!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So please! Let me join you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm okay with him joining...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're trying to discover how the “atmosphere that pushed everyone forward” was born by putting on this event, as well as what's necessary to bring that about, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I believe that we should have those who feel the same way as us participate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're being absolutely serious...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, I am!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The last time I saw him, I was heading home after we discussed putting on our own event... Which was probably sometime past eight at night...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He was practicing all alone like there was no tomorrow... I'm guessing that he was out there pretty late that night.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm taking you at your word...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Good...
You look like you mean it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I agree...!
I'm really glad you're joining us.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Now I've gotta train for it!
Just wait, you guys! You're all gonna be totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we get it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, we appreciate you joining.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it too!
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, everyone here's gonna be in our event! Thanks again, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
Let's make this event a good one.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Definitely. Just let us know if you ever need help finding a place or extra hands.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I'll help with that too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We'll let you know if something does come up. Also, please contact Toya regarding any clerical business.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kohane's gonna be in charge of flyers, and I'm gonna be dealing with who performs in what order along with some other stuff. Let me know if you have any ideas.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Okay, got it.
We'll be counting on you all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, thanks again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As far as venues go, “Ultramarine” should work for us. We performed there once before and it's just the right size for this event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I also heard that the staff there is very flexible with its clients.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... I tried taking some photos for our flyers... What do you guys think?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, these are pretty good...
I thought you were all about snakes and amusement parks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Kohane's the embodiment of good taste!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
N-No one's ever said that about me before...
Studio

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna do a full run together today. You guys all ready...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I warmed up my voice this morning!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Same.
We're ready when you are.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, me too...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing.
Anyway, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
He's been eyeing his phone this entire time...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this run on the road!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (For now, I need to focus on this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Time to see if this crew can produce that atmosphere...)
